biography: Santiago Piug, born in the heart of Barcelona, has always possessed a flair for the dramatic. From tearing around his neighborhood on a souped-up scooter at 14, leaving a trail of bewildered stares and near-misses, to his early days in karting, Piug's style was unmistakable: all or nothing. His entry into professional racing was almost accidental. During a local karting event, a talent scout spotted Santiago overtaking three karts in a single corner with a move that defied physics, leading to his first contract. A defining moment came at the 2021 GT World Challenge Europe race at Imola; despite starting near the back, Piug carved his way through the field, battling established names and ultimately securing a podium finish after a daring last-lap overtake. Now racing for Lamborghini, Piug is viewed as a rising star with the potential to become a major force, though his occasional recklessness remains a point of contention.
drivingStyle: Piug's driving style is characterized by aggressive corner entries and late braking. He's not afraid to push the limits of grip, often flirting with the edge of control. While this approach can lead to spectacular overtakes and blistering lap times, it also makes him prone to errors and tire degradation. He's a master of psychological warfare on the track, using subtle feints and aggressive positioning to unsettle opponents. Under pressure, Piug tends to become even more aggressive, sometimes to his detriment.

famousQuote: "Racing isn't about playing it safe; it's about dancing on the edge of disaster and making it look beautiful."
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 24 Hours of Spa in the GT World Challenge Europe. Despite a gearbox issue in the early hours, Piug and his teammates fought back to secure a stunning victory, with Piug delivering a masterful final stint.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead on the final lap of the 2023 Bathurst 12 Hour. A momentary lapse in concentration led to a costly mistake, costing him and his team a likely victory and attracting considerable criticism.
